notes.title: The realtime multiplayer (Beta) is now available in Dream Car Builder!
notes.notes:
The realtime multiplayer is now available in Dream Car Builder!
     
[b]How to set up a Dream Car Builder Dedicated Server:[/b]
You can download the "DCB Server" tool either through the Steam tool section, or SteamCMD if you would like to avoid signing into steam entirely!

[b]Option 1.[/b]
1. In the Library tab select Tools. Locate "DCB Server" and install it. 
The installation folder: Library -> Tools -> Locate "DCB Server" and right click on it -> Properties -> Local files -> Browse local files...

[b]Option 2.[/b]
1. Make a folder somewhere you will remember, and call it SteamCMD
2. Download the zip from here: https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd.zip
3. Extract steamcmd.zip into the SteamCMD folder
4. Start "steamcmd.exe" then type this after: [code]+login anonymous +force_install_dir c:\DCBServer +app_update 1010510 validate +quit [/code]
"c:\DCBServer" - is the folder you want to install the server to.

When the DCBServer is installed, just start "dcbserver_x64.exe" or "dcbserver_x32.exe" in the DCBServer folder.

You can start several instances of DCB server on one PC using different ports for different maps.

The server ports by default: 
5998, 8766, 27016 (dcbserver_x64_silent.bat)
5999, 8767, 27017 (dcbserver_x64_silent_2nd_instance.bat)
6000, 8768, 27018 (dcbserver_x64_silent_3rd_instance.bat)

In order to host a server, you must have the server ports open and forwarded for UDP and TCP connections (if you use a router), OTHERWISE, YOUR SERVER WILL NOT BE VISIBLE FROM THE INTERNET! 


[b]How to add a map from workshop to your server:[/b]
1. Subscribe to the map you want in Steam Workshop.
2. Find the folder of this Workshop Item on your PC, typically it is:  [code]"d:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\workshop\content\488550\1315180776\" [/code]
3. Start DCBServer
4. Click "Map"
5. Click "+"
6. Choose the Workshop Item Folder


Please, write about all the bugs and comments here: 
https://steamcommunity.com/…/discussi…/0/350541595105338726/

notes.title: Dream Car Builder Full Release
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25996589/7894053e85dfe81899dc03510e01d609ebd0b0ae.jpg[/img]

Today Dream Car Builder moves from early access into a full release. All the things that we promised in the Early Access Game Introduction are now implemented in the game.
The game got 81 updates during these 2 years.
50% of the features were requested by players. Your input suggestions and feedback has been invaluable to us. Thank you guys, you made this game!

The short list:

New parts and settings: 
- Point settings
- Sliders
- Tank steering
- Angle locks
- Spoilers (Panels with aerodynamics)
- Jets
- The new part "Decoration" allows to import 3D objects from .obj files
- 3 types of tires: Universal, Slick, Offroad
- Transmission
- Manual gearbox with the ability to change gear ratios (new engine settings)

New ingame maps:
- Airport
- Canyon
- Canyon 2
- Crash Test Site
- Desert
- Desert 2
- Highlands
- Monticello raceway
- Mountain
- Racing field
- Salt Flats

Controls:
- Controller support
- Ability to assign keyboard buttons for all actions of the race mode.

Gameplay:
- Physics engine has been significantly improved.
- Free camera mode
- The possibility to make custom circular tracks
- The ability to change the width of checkpoints
- The ability to make custom tracks wich are over the ground (on platforms)

User interface:
- The editor user interface is improved
- Groups of parts window in the editor
- Competitions UI improvements
- New ingame tutorial
- 9 new languages: German, Portuguese-Brazil, French, Chinese, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Turkish, Japanese.

Graphics and sounds:
- Soft wheels graphics
- Dust, sparks, skidmarks, new sound effects
- Particles and sounds now slow when you slow down the time.

The full list of updates:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/488550/discussions/0/350542683198384629

notes.notes:
Its been a while since we shared our last update. We are happy to announce that we are now just weeks away from the full release of Dream Car Builder. 

All the things that I promised in the Early Access Game Introduction are now implemented in the game.

50% of the features were requested by players. Thank you guys, you made this game!

Does it mean, that it is the final version of the game?
No, It isn't a final version of the game - we have lots plans about game improvements.

notes.title: The Point settings part is now available in the game!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25996589/b9a650510d9968f6960cf4ddd52791bf0d75aee9.jpg[/img]

v13.2016.10.10.1 ea
Parts:
- Transmissions have been removed
- Driving wheel toggle is in the wheel's parameters now
- A new part: Point settings (ability to add many headlights, change the friction of points, ability to disable collisions)
- The seat's headlight has been removed
- Hide the seat toggle is in the seats's parameters now

Editor:
- Deselecting parts with Shift + click.
- Q - set the camera's center of rotation to the highlighted point or part
- Alt + 0...9 - add the selected parts to the group. Ctrl + 0...9 select the group of parts.
- Tutorial update

Race:
- ability to start race in the sandbox mode with no engines or driving wheels

Bugs fix: Respawn when the seat has midpoint nodes
